        {
            name: "clusterName",
            value: "example",
        },
        {
            name: "environment",
            value: "prod",
        },
    ],
    enableExternal: false,
});
const example = tencentcloud.monitor.getExternalClusterRegisterCommandOutput({
    instanceId: exampleExternalCluster.instanceId,
    clusterId: exampleExternalCluster.clusterId,
});
